lead.description: an index of whether neighbouring areas have more similar values than a random reassignment of those values

overview_sentence: [Moran's I](articles/morans-i.qmd) measures whether neighbouring areas are more alike than a random map.

self_checks.title: Line of four areas
self_checks.prompt: Areas in a line have values 1, 2, 4, and 5, and binary neighbour weights with six nonzero entries. What is Moran's I?

self_checks.title: Sum of the weights
self_checks.prompt: For four areas in a line and binary weights on each ordered neighbour pair, what is the sum of all weights?
self_checks.answer: The sum of the weights is 6.

self_checks.title: Alternating values
self_checks.prompt: The same four areas and weights now have values 1, 2, 2, and 1. What is Moran's I?
